title: UbuntuGuard usb_control policy payload, version 1
description: Declarative USB control intent. This payload contains DATA ONLY: typed device matchers and a mode. It never contains usbguard rule text, shell strings, file paths or commands; enforcerd derives the OS rules itself from these typed fields.

mode.description: monitor_only: observe and report, change nothing. allowlist_enforce: permit only allowlisted or excepted devices in protected_classes, block the rest. block_all_storage: block every device in protected_classes, allowlist ignored (exceptions still apply).

protected_classes.description: USB interface classes subject to enforcement. 'mass_storage' is USB class 08. 'image' is class 06 (PTP/MTP, i.e. phones and cameras) and is OFF by default until the spike shows it can be blocked without breaking normal phone charging.

always_allow_classes.description: Never-block classes. 'hid' (keyboards, mice) and 'hub' are REQUIRED by schema so that no policy can lock a user out of their own laptop. USB-C docks additionally need 'billboard', 'network', 'audio' and 'video'.

exceptions.description: Time-bound admin grants. Maximum duration 24 h. JSON Schema cannot express 'expires_at - created_at <= 24h', so that bound is enforced semantically by BOTH the server (on create) and the agent (on apply), and is covered by test_exception_max_duration.

report_present_at_start.description: Report devices already attached when the agent or daemon starts. Needed because usbguard's DevicePresenceChanged signal for already-present devices does not reliably reach bus clients, so the agent reconciles with listDevices at startup instead of relying on signals alone.

apply_to_present_devices.description: Evaluate the policy against devices that were already attached, rather than leaving them in their current state.

usbId.description: Lowercase 4-digit hex USB vendor or product id, as reported by usbguard.

serial.description: Device serial as reported by usbguard, or null.

serial_match.description: 'exact' pins one physical stick and requires a serial. 'any' matches every unit of that vendor/product model and is the only option for the many cheap sticks that report no serial at all; it is strictly weaker and the dashboard must label it as such.

reason.description: Required justification. Short strings are rejected to discourage 'test' and 'asdf'.

expires_at.description: Absolute UTC expiry. Stored in signed policy state so expiry survives an agent restart and cannot be extended by changing the local clock beyond the 300 s skew tolerance.
